title: A Critical Pair Enumeration Algorithm for String Diagram Rewriting
summary: Critical pair analysis provides a convenient and computable criterion of confluence, which is a fundamental property in rewriting theory, for a wide variety of rewriting systems. Bonchi et al. showed validity of critical pair analysis for rewriting on string diagrams in symmetric monoidal categories. This work aims at automation of critical pair analysis for string diagram rewriting, and develops an algorithm that implements the core part of critical pair analysis.
